advertiser_campaign_list.title: Messaging campaigns
advertiser_campaign_list.description: Manage targeted messaging campaigns to specific audiences.

advertiser_campaign_create.title: Create a campaign
advertiser_campaign_create.description: Configure channels and audience targeting. Drafts can be edited freely.

system_admin_moderation.title: Ad campaign review
system_admin_moderation.description: Review pending campaigns and approve or block them.
system_admin_moderation.approve_dialog_message: Once approved the advertiser can launch delivery.
system_admin_moderation.block_dialog_message: Enter the reason for blocking (it will be sent to the advertiser).

settings_ad_preferences.title: Advertising preferences
settings_ad_preferences.description: Choose which channels you accept ads from and block specific advertisers.
settings_ad_preferences.channel_section_description: Turning off a channel will stop ads from that channel.
settings_ad_preferences.blocked_section_description: Blocked advertisers will not be able to deliver ads to you (max 100).
settings_ad_preferences.blocked_limit_exceeded: You have reached the block limit (100). Please unblock some entries first.
settings_ad_preferences.rotate_tokens_help: Invalidates any unsubscribe links sent in past emails.
settings_ad_preferences.rotate_tokens_confirm: Are you sure you want to invalidate all unsubscribe links? This action cannot be undone.
settings_ad_preferences.consent_required: You need to consent before receiving ads.
settings_ad_preferences.save_rate_limited: You have reached the preference update limit (10 per hour). Please wait and try again.

me_ad_deliveries.title: Ads you received
me_ad_deliveries.description: History of advertising messages delivered to you.
me_ad_deliveries.empty: You have not received any ads yet.
me_ad_deliveries.delete_all_description: Delete all ad delivery history. Advertiser billing records and aggregate statistics will be retained, but their association with you will be removed.
me_ad_deliveries.delete_all_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all ad history? This action cannot be undone.

report_dialog.title: Report this ad
report_dialog.detail_placeholder: Please describe specifically what concerned you
report_dialog.submitted: Thank you. Your report has been received.
report_dialog.rate_limited: You have reached the daily reporting limit (20 per day). Please try again tomorrow.

consent_dialog.title: Accept ad delivery?
consent_dialog.description: Mannschaft delivers limited advertising messages from advertisers. You can change your preferences at any time.
consent_dialog.stopped_message: All ad delivery has been stopped. You can change this anytime in settings.

error_codes.AD_CAMPAIGN_NOT_EDITABLE: This campaign cannot be edited in its current state.
error_codes.AD_CAMPAIGN_INVALID_TRANSITION: This state transition is not allowed.
error_codes.AD_CAMPAIGN_MODERATION_BLOCKED: This campaign was blocked during moderation.
error_codes.AD_CAMPAIGN_NO_CHANNEL: Please configure at least one channel.
error_codes.AD_PREFERENCES_BLOCKED_LIMIT: You can block up to 100 advertisers.
error_codes.AD_REPORT_DUPLICATE: You have already reported this campaign.
error_codes.AD_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Please try again later.
